brief: Rotate a nine-float matrix about the selected original axis using turn-based angles.
decl: void camera_matrix_rotation(std::span<const float,9> source, float turns, std::span<float,9> destination, std::uint32_t axis);

bookkeeping.scope: Three complete matrix rotation bodies with actual original trig children in oracle; host trig equivalent checked on retained finite inputs.
bookkeeping.supported_domain: Finite turns +/-1024, finite matrix magnitudes <=1e20, identical or disjoint source/destination. Partial overlap, exception flags, nonfinite values and x87 return-register precision unmodeled.
bookkeeping.acceptance: 4356 synthetic complete-body cases match MSVC and Zig exactly; focused native tests cover axis invariants, aliases and rejected inputs.
unresolved: Host trig equivalence outside sampled inputs; partial overlap; free-camera and spatial lookup integration.
